name: Tenshou Hanayome Nikki
source:
"Hello and welcome everyone! --- I'm Chigusa Atsumi, host of this fine and funny event."
"And I'm Haru-chan. What are we doing today, Chi-chan?"
"A comedy celestial."
"You mean to say a comedy special, right?"
"Yeah, if you want to suck all the fun out of it."
"That's more mature."
"It's more mature, yes."
"So anyway, where do we start?"
"Our first batter is a duo of up-and-coming young talents."
"I wonder what they're like!"
"That's what I'm excited to see as well! --- I don't think anyone knows about this duo yet."
"Be still my heart. Right, Chi-can, let's get under way."
"Ladies and gentleman, give it up for our first performers: Keita!"

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE120623.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“大家好，欢迎大家！——我是千草厚美，这次精彩又有趣的活动的主持人。”
“我是Haru-chan。Chi-chan，我们今天要做什么？”
“喜剧天王。”
“你的意思是说一部喜剧特辑，对吧？”
“是的，如果你想从中吸取所有乐趣的话。”
“这样更成熟了。”
“它更成熟了，是的。”
“那么，我们从哪里开始呢？”
“我们的第一击球手是一对崭露头角的年轻天才组合。”
“我想知道他们是什么样子的！”
“这也是我很高兴看到的！——我想还没有人知道这个二人组。”
“我的心要安静。好吧，Chi-can，我们出发吧。”
“女士们先生们，请让给我们的第一位表演者：凯塔！”

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE120623.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
